name: record-type-inclusion-test-10e02d3ce3/cyclic-inclusion-via-field-v.bal
spec_references: Subset restrictions > Import declarations: Only following lang libraries with given methods/types are supported; ballerina/lang.error lists only message.
Subset restrictions > Invocations > Other invocation restrictions: Method call syntax can be used for calling the following langlib functions: error:message.
reason: The runtime cast-error test calls e.detail() and asserts the exact message stored in the returned error detail mapping. lang.error:detail is absent from both the supported error-library methods and the method-syntax allowlist, so the whole case requires an unsupported operation.
test_design_notes: The unsupported detail call is essential to an explicit assertion, not instrumentation. The io:println reference is instrumentation alone.
